**Orbweaver 1.0.10 shows a locked, headless Mac's usage on your phone.**

## What's fixed

- **A Mac sitting at its lock screen now sends usage to the phone.** Before, account usage was polled only after someone logged in at the console, so a headless Mac (like an always-locked Mac mini) never showed any usage accounts on the phone. It now polls and sends usage while locked, with the same settings and schedule. (CB-391)
- **Test reliability.** Fixed several tests that failed at random on CI, and persona tests that failed on Windows machines with a persona file in the home folder. No change to the app itself.

## Upgrading

- Install 1.0.10 from the update notice, or by hand as usual.
- **macOS:** if your other machines, OpenClaw or the phone relay stop connecting after the upgrade, re-grant Local Network in **System Settings → Privacy & Security**.
